claims.description: Table 1 (page 27), Overall, SMD. Code: Delta of row 'Overall' in meta_table from scripts/table-one-meta.R
Table 1, Theory: Choice Architecture, SMD. Code: Delta of row 'Choice Architecture'
Table 1, Theory: Psychology, SMD. Code: Delta of row 'Psychology'

notes: Claims are Table 1's first three point estimates (SMD column) read row by row; study and estimate counts are not point estimates. Values confirmed in the PDF text layer, page 27. Tolerance tightened before running: the rerun must round to the printed two-decimal value (+-0.005); the protocol rule would allow +-0.03 on 0.07, which says nothing. Run: a driver sources libraries.R, functions.R, load-data.R and models-and-constants.R in the order of PDF-MAP-reduction-meta.Rmd, sets word=FALSE as that file does, then evaluates the first expression of table-one-meta.R (which builds meta_table) and writes the three Delta values. No author file is edited.
